material.text: It dipped to its rising 20-day average in the last three sessions and held above it.
material.learn: The average close of the last 20, 50 or 200 sessions; rising averages mark uptrends and often act as support.

material.head: Strong uptrend (ADX 28)
material.text: Trend strength (ADX) reads 28, above the 25 that marks a strong trend, with buyers in control of the directional lines.
material.learn: A 0-100 gauge of trend strength, not direction; above 25 is a strong trend.

material.head: 1 of the desk's strategy kind buying
material.text: The desk's own strategies signaled a buy: 1 kind of strategy.
material.learn: The desk's own trading rules; when several kinds agree on a name, the read counts it.
